answer: Quartz-Beacon Operator Liability Escrow.** Each agent wallet is issued a hardware beacon that signs attestations jointly with a quartz-timestamped operator key. When N wallets cluster by shared operator key and trigger abuse, the protocol slashes that operator's escrowed timber-collateral pool—not the wallets. Sybils become unprofitable because forging identities costs the operator real collateral per cluster, while honest single-wallet operators post minimal escrow.
